authorisation: The Product Owner's remediation mission of 2026-11-06 (D97): deployment to the test appliance 172.21.96.97 only.
delivery: The test appliance was upgraded with appliance-install.sh --upgrade to master 5d09ab7396a1 (the merge of PR #380, carrying #378-#380) at 12:58 UTC: no migration (schema ledger head 0210), the Gate-P reconcile (GATEP_RECONCILE = OK), every service binary and the Admin Console replaced, the release's Caddy unit installed without a Caddy restart (description only), the unused stayconnect-redis container removed (no key, no other client, no Central on the host; volume kept), log_lock_waits set by ALTER SYSTEM with a reload, and the monitor installed from the release.
verification: Every binary (scd, edged, pmsd, portald, netd, acctd, keybootstrap, svc-run) matched the release by SHA-256; the release reads back vcs.revision 5d09ab7396a1, -tags=stayconnect_production, vcs.modified=false; APPLIANCE_UNITS = PASS; nine services active; 474 sessions online after the restart and the only session ended in the window a normal lease expiry. Before and 25 minutes after: devices created since the upgrade carry first_seen (20 of 20) while the 1,113 earlier NULL values are unchanged; Redis absent; Caddy unit current; log_lock_waits on with log_error_verbosity terse and log_min_error_statement panic; monitor d642f928715e4413 on its timers. Live: portald asked scd for reconnection about six times a minute behind the HTTPS portal (about once a minute before), and an Android device's /generate_204 probe reconnected it to its own package as a REJOIN session at 13:13:53; 13 of the 14 devices the monitor still counts as waiting sent no probe after the upgrade. NOT VERIFIED: the reconnection rate over a full day, iOS and Windows probes behind HTTPS on real devices, and a deadlock trace (none occurred in the window).
